  surgery goes to the surgical specialty that performs it).

- If the message has no medical content, or is too vague to choose, answer "Unclear".

- Cardiothoracic Surgery: Surgery on the heart, lungs, chest and major blood vessels: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open heart surgery, aortic surgery
    Route here when: A heart, lung, chest or aortic operation is planned or recommended: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open-heart surgery, aortic aneurysm surgery
    Not here: Medicines, angiography or stents only → Cardiology; heart surgery for a child's congenital defect → Pediatric Cardiology
- Pediatric Cardiology: Heart conditions in babies and children, including congenital heart defects

    Route here when: Confirmed or suspected cancer and its treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, cancer surgery
    Not here: Blood cancers (leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma) and bone marrow transplant → Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant; brain tumour surgery → Neurosurgery
- Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant: Blood disorders and bone marrow transplant: leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, thalassemia, anaemia, bleeding disorders
    Route here when: Blood disorders and blood cancers: anaemia, thalassaemia, sickle cell, haemophilia, leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma; bone marrow or stem cell transplant
    Not here: Kidney, liver, heart or lung transplant → Organ Transplant; solid tumours → Oncology
- Orthopaedics: Bones, joints, spine and sports injuries: fractures, joint replacement, arthritis, back pain

    Not here: Brain or spinal cord surgery for tumours or nerve compression → Neurosurgery; nerve disease without an injury → Neurology
- Neurology: Brain, spinal cord and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's, neuropathy
    Route here when: Brain and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's disease, dementia, neuropathy, multiple sclerosis
    Not here: Brain tumour, aneurysm or spine surgery → Neurosurgery; a problem of the eye itself → Ophthalmology
- Neurosurgery: Surgery of the brain, spine and nerves: brain tumours, aneurysms, spinal cord compression, hydrocephalus
    Route here when: Surgery on the brain, spinal cord or nerves: brain tumour, aneurysm, hydrocephalus, spinal cord compression, head injury surgery
    Not here: Stroke, epilepsy or headaches treated without surgery → Neurology
- Gastroenterology: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, IBD, hepatitis, endoscopy
    Route here when: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, liver disease, jaundice, inflammatory bowel disease, endoscopy, colonoscopy
    Not here: Liver transplant → Organ Transplant; cancer of a digestive organ → Oncology

    Route here when: Kidney disease treated with medicines or dialysis: chronic kidney disease, kidney failure, protein in urine

    Route here when: Urinary tract and male reproductive organs: kidney and ureter stones, prostate, bladder, urine infection, incontinence

    Route here when: Solid-organ transplant: kidney, liver, heart or lung, including living donor transplants

    Route here when: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive organs: periods, fibroids, ovarian cysts, menopause, hysterectomy

    Not here: Pregnancy care and delivery → Obstetrics & Gynaecology

    Route here when: Children's general health and childhood illnesses, newborn and premature baby care
    Not here: A child whose problem has its own speciality is routed by the problem: heart defect → Pediatric Cardiology, cleft lip → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, liver transplant → Organ Transplant

    Route here when: Hormone and gland conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, pituitary and adrenal disorders
    Not here: Weight-loss surgery → Bariatric Surgery; diabetic damage to the eyes or kidneys → Ophthalmology or Nephrology

    Route here when: Lungs and breathing: asthma, COPD, tuberculosis, pneumonia, persistent cough, sleep apnoea
    Not here: Chest pain with heart symptoms → Cardiology; a patient on a ventilator or in intensive care → Critical Care
- Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery: Reconstruction after burns, injury, cancer or birth defects, and cosmetic surgery
    Route here when: Reconstruction and repair: burn scars, cleft lip and palate, skin grafts, cosmetic surgery, hair transplant
    Not here: A fresh burn injury → Emergency Medicine

    Route here when: Severe obesity where weight-loss surgery is considered: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
    Not here: Hormonal causes of weight gain → Endocrinology

    Route here when: Accidents, injuries, poisoning, severe allergic reactions and other problems needing care now
    Not here: A planned or long-standing problem → the speciality that treats it

    Route here when: A critically ill patient who needs intensive care: ICU, ventilator, sepsis, multi-organ failure
    Not here: Urgent but stable problems → Emergency Medicine

    Route here when: Eyes and vision: cataract, glaucoma, retina, squint, eye infections, LASIK
    Not here: Vision loss caused by a brain or nerve condition → Neurology
- ENT: Ear, nose and throat: hearing loss, sinus, tonsils, voice problems, cochlear implants
    Route here when: Ear, nose, throat and voice: hearing loss, sinusitis, tonsils, hoarse voice, cochlear implant
    Not here: Lung or breathing disease → Pulmonology; cancer of the mouth or throat → Oncology
- Dermatology: Skin, hair and nail conditions: psoriasis, eczema, acne, vitiligo, fungal infections
    Route here when: Skin, hair and nails: rashes, eczema, psoriasis, acne, fungal infections, hair loss
    Not here: Burn scars or skin reconstruction → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery

    Route here when: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, addiction, sleep problems

  surgery goes to the surgical specialty that performs it).
- Babies and children go to the paediatric specialty when one fits.
- If the message has no medical content, or is too vague to choose, answer "Unclear".
- alternatives: up to 2 other specialties that could also be right, most likely first.
- evidence_terms: the exact words from the message that drove your choice.

Specialties:
- Cardiology: Heart and blood vessel conditions treated with medicines, angiography, angioplasty, stents and pacemakers
    Route here when: Heart condition managed with medicines, tests or catheter procedures: angina, heart attack care, arrhythmia, heart failure, high blood pressure, angioplasty, stents, pacemaker
    Not here: A planned heart or chest operation (bypass, valve replacement) → Cardiothoracic Surgery; a child's heart defect → Pediatric Cardiology; breathlessness from lung disease → Pulmonology
- Cardiothoracic Surgery: Surgery on the heart, lungs, chest and major blood vessels: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open heart surgery, aortic surgery
    Route here when: A heart, lung, chest or aortic operation is planned or recommended: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open-heart surgery, aortic aneurysm surgery
    Not here: Medicines, angiography or stents only → Cardiology; heart surgery for a child's congenital defect → Pediatric Cardiology
- Pediatric Cardiology: Heart conditions in babies and children, including congenital heart defects
    Route here when: A baby or child with a heart problem, usually present from birth: hole in the heart (VSD/ASD), tetralogy of Fallot, blue baby
    Not here: Heart disease in an adult → Cardiology
- Oncology: Cancer diagnosis and treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy and cancer surgery
    Route here when: Confirmed or suspected cancer and its treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, cancer surgery
    Not here: Blood cancers (leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma) and bone marrow transplant → Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant; brain tumour surgery → Neurosurgery
- Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant: Blood disorders and bone marrow transplant: leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, thalassemia, anaemia, bleeding disorders
    Route here when: Blood disorders and blood cancers: anaemia, thalassaemia, sickle cell, haemophilia, leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma; bone marrow or stem cell transplant
    Not here: Kidney, liver, heart or lung transplant → Organ Transplant; solid tumours → Oncology
- Orthopaedics: Bones, joints, spine and sports injuries: fractures, joint replacement, arthritis, back pain
    Route here when: Bones, joints, ligaments and spine: fractures, arthritis, joint replacement, sports injuries, slipped disc, back and neck problems
    Not here: Brain or spinal cord surgery for tumours or nerve compression → Neurosurgery; nerve disease without an injury → Neurology
- Neurology: Brain, spinal cord and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's, neuropathy
    Route here when: Brain and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's disease, dementia, neuropathy, multiple sclerosis
    Not here: Brain tumour, aneurysm or spine surgery → Neurosurgery; a problem of the eye itself → Ophthalmology
- Neurosurgery: Surgery of the brain, spine and nerves: brain tumours, aneurysms, spinal cord compression, hydrocephalus
    Route here when: Surgery on the brain, spinal cord or nerves: brain tumour, aneurysm, hydrocephalus, spinal cord compression, head injury surgery
    Not here: Stroke, epilepsy or headaches treated without surgery → Neurology
- Gastroenterology: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, IBD, hepatitis, endoscopy
    Route here when: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, liver disease, jaundice, inflammatory bowel disease, endoscopy, colonoscopy
    Not here: Liver transplant → Organ Transplant; cancer of a digestive organ → Oncology
- Nephrology: Kidney disease treated medically: chronic kidney disease, dialysis, protein in urine
    Route here when: Kidney disease treated with medicines or dialysis: chronic kidney disease, kidney failure, protein in urine
    Not here: Kidney or ureter stones, prostate and bladder problems → Urology; kidney transplant → Organ Transplant

    Route here when: Urinary tract and male reproductive organs: kidney and ureter stones, prostate, bladder, urine infection, incontinence
    Not here: Kidney failure or dialysis → Nephrology; male infertility treatment → Reproductive Medicine
- Organ Transplant: Kidney, liver, heart and other organ transplants, including living donor transplants
    Route here when: Solid-organ transplant: kidney, liver, heart or lung, including living donor transplants
    Not here: Bone marrow or stem cell transplant → Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant; hair transplant → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
- Obstetrics & Gynaecology: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive health: fibroids, ovarian cysts, menstrual problems, hysterectomy
    Route here when: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive organs: periods, fibroids, ovarian cysts, menopause, hysterectomy
    Not here: Infertility or IVF → Reproductive Medicine; cancer of the breast, uterus or ovary → Oncology
- Reproductive Medicine: Infertility treatment: IVF, ICSI, IUI, egg freezing, male infertility
    Route here when: Trouble conceiving and fertility treatment: IVF, IUI, ICSI, egg freezing, male or female infertility
    Not here: Pregnancy care and delivery → Obstetrics & Gynaecology
- Paediatrics: Medical care for babies, children and adolescents, including newborn care and development
    Route here when: Children's general health and childhood illnesses, newborn and premature baby care
    Not here: A child whose problem has its own speciality is routed by the problem: heart defect → Pediatric Cardiology, cleft lip → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, liver transplant → Organ Transplant
- Endocrinology: Hormone and metabolic conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, obesity, growth and adrenal problems
    Route here when: Hormone and gland conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, pituitary and adrenal disorders
    Not here: Weight-loss surgery → Bariatric Surgery; diabetic damage to the eyes or kidneys → Ophthalmology or Nephrology
- Pulmonology: Lung and breathing conditions: asthma, COPD, TB, pneumonia, sleep apnoea
    Route here when: Lungs and breathing: asthma, COPD, tuberculosis, pneumonia, persistent cough, sleep apnoea
    Not here: Chest pain with heart symptoms → Cardiology; a patient on a ventilator or in intensive care → Critical Care
- Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery: Reconstruction after burns, injury, cancer or birth defects, and cosmetic surgery
    Route here when: Reconstruction and repair: burn scars, cleft lip and palate, skin grafts, cosmetic surgery, hair transplant
    Not here: A fresh burn injury → Emergency Medicine
- Bariatric Surgery: Weight-loss surgery for severe obesity: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
    Route here when: Severe obesity where weight-loss surgery is considered: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
    Not here: Hormonal causes of weight gain → Endocrinology
- Emergency Medicine: Immediate care for accidents, injuries, poisoning and sudden life-threatening problems
    Route here when: Accidents, injuries, poisoning, severe allergic reactions and other problems needing care now
    Not here: A planned or long-standing problem → the speciality that treats it
- Critical Care: Intensive care (ICU) for critically ill patients: ventilator support, sepsis, multi-organ failure
    Route here when: A critically ill patient who needs intensive care: ICU, ventilator, sepsis, multi-organ failure
    Not here: Urgent but stable problems → Emergency Medicine
- Ophthalmology: Eye conditions: cataract, glaucoma, retina problems, vision loss, eye infections
    Route here when: Eyes and vision: cataract, glaucoma, retina, squint, eye infections, LASIK
    Not here: Vision loss caused by a brain or nerve condition → Neurology
- ENT: Ear, nose and throat: hearing loss, sinus, tonsils, voice problems, cochlear implants
    Route here when: Ear, nose, throat and voice: hearing loss, sinusitis, tonsils, hoarse voice, cochlear implant
    Not here: Lung or breathing disease → Pulmonology; cancer of the mouth or throat → Oncology
- Dermatology: Skin, hair and nail conditions: psoriasis, eczema, acne, vitiligo, fungal infections
    Route here when: Skin, hair and nails: rashes, eczema, psoriasis, acne, fungal infections, hair loss
    Not here: Burn scars or skin reconstruction → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
- Psychiatry: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic attacks, addiction, sleep and behaviour problems
    Route here when: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, addiction, sleep problems
    Not here: Memory loss from dementia → Neurology
- General Medicine: First point of care for common illness, fevers, infections and general check-ups when no specialty is clear
    Route here when: General or unclear illness and infections: fever, malaria, dengue, typhoid, fatigue, health check-ups
    Not here: A message that names a specific condition or procedure → that speciality

Return lists of short phrases COPIED word for word from the message (a report text may be included):
- conditions: diseases, diagnoses, symptoms or test findings the message states (e.g. "osteoarthritis of both knees", "triple vessel disease", "blurry vision")
- procedures: treatments, surgeries or tests the patient needs or was advised (e.g. "knee replacement", "CABG", "IVF")
- body_parts: organs or body areas mentioned (e.g. "knee", "heart", "kidney")
- named_diagnoses: only diseases or diagnoses the patient says they HAVE or were told they have, by name (e.g. "asthma", "migraine", "kidney stone", "breast cancer"). Not symptoms, not a guess. Empty if none is named.
- symptom_areas: every symptom or complaint the patient describes, each with ONE tag from this list:
  heart_vessels: chest pain, palpitations, racing heart, swollen leg veins, varicose veins
  headache: headache, migraine, head pain
  brain_nerves: dizziness, lightheaded, poor balance, numbness, tingling, tremor, fits, weakness of one side, memory loss
  bones_joints_muscles: joint pain, swollen joints, back pain, neck pain, stiffness, fracture, muscle weakness
  digestion: stomach pain, heartburn, indigestion, bloating, diarrhoea, constipation, yellow skin or eyes, blood in stool
  nausea_vomiting: nausea, vomiting, feeling like throwing up
  kidneys_urinary: frequent urination, burning urine, blood in urine, kidney stone, cannot pass urine
  lungs_breathing: cough, breathlessness, wheezing, phlegm, chest congestion
  eyes: blurred vision, loss of sight, red eye, eye pain, watery eyes
  ear: ear pain, hearing loss, ringing in the ear, ear discharge
  nose_sinuses: runny or blocked nose, sneezing, sinus pain, loss of smell, nosebleed
  throat_mouth: sore throat, trouble swallowing, hoarse voice, sour or metallic taste, bad breath, mouth ulcer
  skin_hair: rash, itching, spots, sores, peeling skin, hair loss
  womens_health: period problems, pregnancy, vaginal discharge, pelvic pain in women
  fertility: unable to conceive, trying for a baby
  hormones: excessive thirst, weight gain, feeling hot or cold all the time, thyroid swelling
  mental_health: low mood, anxiety, poor sleep, no motivation, panic
  general: fever, chills, sweating, tiredness, weakness all over, body aches, weight loss, loss of appetite, feeling unwell
- self_harm: if the patient says THEY want to die, end their life, kill or harm themselves, or are thinking about suicide (in any language or spelling, e.g. "commiting sucide", "mar jaana chahta hoon", "I don't want to wake up"), copy those words exactly. Otherwise an empty string. Not about other people, not about past events of others.

Rules:
- Use the patient's own words. Keep each phrase short (1 to 6 words).
- Do not output a phrase that is not in the message.
- Tag what the symptom is, not what might cause it (e.g. "headache" is headache, "vomiting" is nausea_vomiting, "fever" is general).
- List EVERY symptom in symptom_areas, including anything mentioned only once.
- Use "general" ONLY for fever, chills, sweating, tiredness or weakness all over, body aches, weight loss, loss of appetite or feeling unwell. A symptom of a body part is never "general": tag the body part (e.g. "red swollen face" is skin_hair, "fungal infection between the toes" is skin_hair, "ringing in the ears" is ear).
- If the message has no medical content, return empty lists.

My newborn was born at 29 weeks and needs NICU care.

prompt:
You help international patients find the right kind of hospital department in India.
This is hospital discovery, not diagnosis. Read the patient's message and choose the ONE
medical specialty from the list below that the patient should be routed to first.

Rules:
- Choose only from the list. Use the exact name.
- If the patient names a diagnosis or a planned procedure, route by that (for example, a planned
  surgery goes to the surgical specialty that performs it).
- Babies and children go to the paediatric specialty when one fits.
- If the message has no medical content, or is too vague to choose, answer "Unclear".
- alternatives: up to 2 other specialties that could also be right, most likely first.
- evidence_terms: the exact words from the message that drove your choice.

Specialties:
- Cardiology: Heart and blood vessel conditions treated with medicines, angiography, angioplasty, stents and pacemakers
    Route here when: Heart condition managed with medicines, tests or catheter procedures: angina, heart attack care, arrhythmia, heart failure, high blood pressure, angioplasty, stents, pacemaker
    Not here: A planned heart or chest operation (bypass, valve replacement) → Cardiothoracic Surgery; a child's heart defect → Pediatric Cardiology; breathlessness from lung disease → Pulmonology
- Cardiothoracic Surgery: Surgery on the heart, lungs, chest and major blood vessels: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open heart surgery, aortic surgery
    Route here when: A heart, lung, chest or aortic operation is planned or recommended: bypass (CABG), valve repair or replacement, open-heart surgery, aortic aneurysm surgery
    Not here: Medicines, angiography or stents only → Cardiology; heart surgery for a child's congenital defect → Pediatric Cardiology
- Pediatric Cardiology: Heart conditions in babies and children, including congenital heart defects
    Route here when: A baby or child with a heart problem, usually present from birth: hole in the heart (VSD/ASD), tetralogy of Fallot, blue baby
    Not here: Heart disease in an adult → Cardiology
- Oncology: Cancer diagnosis and treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy and cancer surgery
    Route here when: Confirmed or suspected cancer and its treatment: chemotherapy, radiotherapy, cancer surgery
    Not here: Blood cancers (leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma) and bone marrow transplant → Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant; brain tumour surgery → Neurosurgery
- Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant: Blood disorders and bone marrow transplant: leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, thalassemia, anaemia, bleeding disorders
    Route here when: Blood disorders and blood cancers: anaemia, thalassaemia, sickle cell, haemophilia, leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma; bone marrow or stem cell transplant
    Not here: Kidney, liver, heart or lung transplant → Organ Transplant; solid tumours → Oncology
- Orthopaedics: Bones, joints, spine and sports injuries: fractures, joint replacement, arthritis, back pain
    Route here when: Bones, joints, ligaments and spine: fractures, arthritis, joint replacement, sports injuries, slipped disc, back and neck problems
    Not here: Brain or spinal cord surgery for tumours or nerve compression → Neurosurgery; nerve disease without an injury → Neurology
- Neurology: Brain, spinal cord and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's, neuropathy
    Route here when: Brain and nerve conditions treated without surgery: stroke, epilepsy, headache, migraine, Parkinson's disease, dementia, neuropathy, multiple sclerosis
    Not here: Brain tumour, aneurysm or spine surgery → Neurosurgery; a problem of the eye itself → Ophthalmology
- Neurosurgery: Surgery of the brain, spine and nerves: brain tumours, aneurysms, spinal cord compression, hydrocephalus
    Route here when: Surgery on the brain, spinal cord or nerves: brain tumour, aneurysm, hydrocephalus, spinal cord compression, head injury surgery
    Not here: Stroke, epilepsy or headaches treated without surgery → Neurology
- Gastroenterology: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, IBD, hepatitis, endoscopy
    Route here when: Stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas and gallbladder: acidity, ulcers, liver disease, jaundice, inflammatory bowel disease, endoscopy, colonoscopy
    Not here: Liver transplant → Organ Transplant; cancer of a digestive organ → Oncology
- Nephrology: Kidney disease treated medically: chronic kidney disease, dialysis, protein in urine
    Route here when: Kidney disease treated with medicines or dialysis: chronic kidney disease, kidney failure, protein in urine
    Not here: Kidney or ureter stones, prostate and bladder problems → Urology; kidney transplant → Organ Transplant
- Urology: Urinary tract and male reproductive organs: kidney stones, prostate, bladder problems
    Route here when: Urinary tract and male reproductive organs: kidney and ureter stones, prostate, bladder, urine infection, incontinence
    Not here: Kidney failure or dialysis → Nephrology; male infertility treatment → Reproductive Medicine
- Organ Transplant: Kidney, liver, heart and other organ transplants, including living donor transplants
    Route here when: Solid-organ transplant: kidney, liver, heart or lung, including living donor transplants
    Not here: Bone marrow or stem cell transplant → Hematology & Bone Marrow Transplant; hair transplant → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
- Obstetrics & Gynaecology: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive health: fibroids, ovarian cysts, menstrual problems, hysterectomy
    Route here when: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's reproductive organs: periods, fibroids, ovarian cysts, menopause, hysterectomy
    Not here: Infertility or IVF → Reproductive Medicine; cancer of the breast, uterus or ovary → Oncology
- Reproductive Medicine: Infertility treatment: IVF, ICSI, IUI, egg freezing, male infertility
    Route here when: Trouble conceiving and fertility treatment: IVF, IUI, ICSI, egg freezing, male or female infertility
    Not here: Pregnancy care and delivery → Obstetrics & Gynaecology
- Paediatrics: Medical care for babies, children and adolescents, including newborn care and development
    Route here when: Children's general health and childhood illnesses, newborn and premature baby care
    Not here: A child whose problem has its own speciality is routed by the problem: heart defect → Pediatric Cardiology, cleft lip → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, liver transplant → Organ Transplant
- Endocrinology: Hormone and metabolic conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, obesity, growth and adrenal problems
    Route here when: Hormone and gland conditions: diabetes, thyroid, PCOS, pituitary and adrenal disorders
    Not here: Weight-loss surgery → Bariatric Surgery; diabetic damage to the eyes or kidneys → Ophthalmology or Nephrology
- Pulmonology: Lung and breathing conditions: asthma, COPD, TB, pneumonia, sleep apnoea
    Route here when: Lungs and breathing: asthma, COPD, tuberculosis, pneumonia, persistent cough, sleep apnoea
    Not here: Chest pain with heart symptoms → Cardiology; a patient on a ventilator or in intensive care → Critical Care
- Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery: Reconstruction after burns, injury, cancer or birth defects, and cosmetic surgery
    Route here when: Reconstruction and repair: burn scars, cleft lip and palate, skin grafts, cosmetic surgery, hair transplant
    Not here: A fresh burn injury → Emergency Medicine
- Bariatric Surgery: Weight-loss surgery for severe obesity: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
    Route here when: Severe obesity where weight-loss surgery is considered: gastric sleeve, gastric bypass, gastric balloon
    Not here: Hormonal causes of weight gain → Endocrinology
- Emergency Medicine: Immediate care for accidents, injuries, poisoning and sudden life-threatening problems
    Route here when: Accidents, injuries, poisoning, severe allergic reactions and other problems needing care now
    Not here: A planned or long-standing problem → the speciality that treats it
- Critical Care: Intensive care (ICU) for critically ill patients: ventilator support, sepsis, multi-organ failure
    Route here when: A critically ill patient who needs intensive care: ICU, ventilator, sepsis, multi-organ failure
    Not here: Urgent but stable problems → Emergency Medicine
- Ophthalmology: Eye conditions: cataract, glaucoma, retina problems, vision loss, eye infections
    Route here when: Eyes and vision: cataract, glaucoma, retina, squint, eye infections, LASIK
    Not here: Vision loss caused by a brain or nerve condition → Neurology
- ENT: Ear, nose and throat: hearing loss, sinus, tonsils, voice problems, cochlear implants
    Route here when: Ear, nose, throat and voice: hearing loss, sinusitis, tonsils, hoarse voice, cochlear implant
    Not here: Lung or breathing disease → Pulmonology; cancer of the mouth or throat → Oncology
- Dermatology: Skin, hair and nail conditions: psoriasis, eczema, acne, vitiligo, fungal infections
    Route here when: Skin, hair and nails: rashes, eczema, psoriasis, acne, fungal infections, hair loss
    Not here: Burn scars or skin reconstruction → Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
- Psychiatry: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic attacks, addiction, sleep and behaviour problems
    Route here when: Mental health: depression, anxiety, panic, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, addiction, sleep problems
    Not here: Memory loss from dementia → Neurology
- General Medicine: First point of care for common illness, fevers, infections and general check-ups when no specialty is clear
    Route here when: General or unclear illness and infections: fever, malaria, dengue, typhoid, fatigue, health check-ups
    Not here: A message that names a specific condition or procedure → that speciality
